messages:
kevin: heads up — installing redwoodctl inside WSL2 (Ubuntu 22.04) and login is weird. it opens the Windows credential prompt briefly then nothing, CLI sits showing 'Waiting for authentication...' and eventually times out. anyone seen WSL credential shims behave like this?
lina: WSL doesn't have a native secret-service. some apps try to talk to gnome-keyring and fall back to a compat layer that forwards to Windows Credential Manager. which package did you install? deb or snap?
kevin: installed the .deb from releases. redwoodctl tries secret-service, then times out ~20s repeatedly before falling back to a file store. that delay kills our CI. also local `redwoodctl local-serve` binds to localhost and from Windows side it can't reach it without exposing on 0.0.0.0. two separate DX hits.
sam: for the cred thing, we had a helper at another company that used wincred via a small daemon (socat+named pipe) but that's fragile. better: CLI should detect WSL by /proc/version and skip secret-service probe (or probe fast <1s) and try file backend or a wincred backend immediately.
lina: agreed. PR idea: env var REDWOODCTL_CRED_BACKEND with values [auto|secretservice|file|wincred] and default auto. in WSL auto -> wincred|file quickly. Also surface a helpful message when Windows credential UI was invoked (so users know why it flickered).
kevin: workaround i used: `export REDWOODCTL_CRED_BACKEND=file` before login and precreate `~/.local/share/redwoodctl/credentials.json` with correct perms. login succeeds instantly. local-serve workaround: `redwoodctl local-serve --bind 0.0.0.0` then access via `localhost:PORT` from Windows host. adding both to onboarding doc for WSL users.
sam: also watch path permissions: when packaging we sometimes ship a default credentials.json owned by root which breaks WSL because linuxfs->winperm maps can be funky. packagers should avoid creating per-user files and let first-run create them.
lina: i'll open a small issue: detect WSL and prefer file/wincred and expose REDWOODCTL_CRED_BACKEND. also add a short note in docs about local-serve binding and WSL networking caveats.
win-bot: created ticket #4620: "WSL: secret-service probe causes flicker and long timeouts; add REDWOODCTL_CRED_BACKEND and WSL detection; document local-serve bind caveat" assigned to @lina.
kevin: thanks! workaround works and i'll update onboarding script for dev machines. :rocket:
